hooks.command: echo '$FILE_PATH' | grep -iE '(\.env|credentials|token|secret|\.pem|\.key|id_rsa|id_ed25519)' && echo '[Hook] ⚠ 敏感文件修改需确认' && exit 1 || exit 0
grep -n "console\.log\|console\.warn\|console\.error" "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null && echo "[Hook] ⚠ console.log found in $FILE_PATH" || true
hooks.description: 检查编辑的文件是否有 console.log

hooks.command: if echo '$FILE_PATH' | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false "$FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | head -10; fi
grep -n '[\x80-\xff]' "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null && echo '[Hook] ⚠ 发现非 ASCII 字符，可能影响终端显示' || true
wc -l "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null | awk '{if($1>500) print "[Hook] ⚠ 文件超过500行: "$1"行"}'
grep -l 'Ink\|React' "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null && echo '[Hook] ✅ TUI 组件文件' || true
hooks.description: 标记 TUI 组件文件

hooks.command: if grep -rn "console\.log" /d/claude-code-haha/src/ --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "node_modules" | grep -v ".test." | grep -v "//.*console"; then echo "[Hook] ⚠ 发现未删除的 console.log"; else echo "[Hook] ✅ 无 console.log"; fi
hooks.description: 检查项目中残留的 console.log

hooks.command: powershell -Command "& { $title = 'Claude Code'; $msg = 'Task completed at ' + (Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm'); [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager, Windows.UI.Notifications, ContentType = WindowsRuntime]::CreateToastNotifier($title).Show([Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotification]::new([Windows.Data.Xml.Dom.XmlDocument]::new(('<toast><visual><binding template="ToastText02"><text id="1">' + $title + '</text><text id="2">' + $msg + '</text></binding></visual></toast>')))) }" 2>&1 || true
